note: Shared art palette. Element colors come from src/data/elements.json; this file holds the rest. Gray tokens in dragon parts, enemy body plans and the breath puff are swapped for real colors once at load time.

lighting.note: Lighting pass added to every rig part once at load (src/ui/stage/rigs.ts): a top light and bottom shade over the part's own shape, and a rim on edges facing the light. Opacities 0 to 1; rim offset in share of the canvas height.

lookB.note: Look B, the comparison look on #/dev/mock (docs/GRAPHICS_PLAN_2.md): outlines take a dark version of the color they surround, characters are tinted toward the scene's light, and a paper grain sits over the stage.
